title: security-compliance-review-prep-1on1-priya-desai
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep with Security lead (Jordan) + external audit sync (informal notes)
Date: 2026-03-05 (prep for week of 3/8 auditor kickoff)
Location: Zoom / Security war room channel #sec-audit

Goals for this 1:1:
- Align on what we hand to auditors as evidence for SOC2 period (Jan 2025 - Dec 2025).
- Confirm owner matrix for each control (CC/ISO controls mapping).
- Surface any last-minute artifacts we still need (logs, configs, contracts).
- Agree on timeline for remediation evidence and final sign-offs.

High-level status (notes to self):
- SOC2: Control mapping mostly done, coverage gaps around change management (CM) and vendor management (VM).
- ISO27001: Gap analysis doc exists but need clarified scope for on-prem customers.
- Vendor risk: ~12 vendors flagged as medium/high; contracts missing updated DPA for 3 vendors.
- Pen testing: 2025-11 report complete; remediation tickets created but 2 low findings still open (infra team).

Quick ask list for Jordan (during 1:1):
- Confirm whether auditors will accept Jira tickets as evidence for remediation (we currently have PR + Jira references).
- Clarify expected format for KMS/HSM evidence (audit wants key rotation logs and KMS policy snapshots).
- Do we need per-tenant encryption attestation for Dedicated customers?
- Confirm cutoff date for evidence ingestion (we should aim to freeze artifacts by 3/12).

Evidence checklist (what I think we have vs missing):
- Access control: ok (Okta SSO logs, groups export) -> missing: export for service accounts created before 2024 (ask infra).
- Change management: partial -> we have RFC emails + deploy runbooks but missing consistent approval trail for infra changes -> ACTION: Samir/infra to produce approval exports (due 3/10).
- Incident response: OK -> Postmortems for 2025 incidents linked, tabletop exercise notes (Jan 2026) included.
- Vulnerability mgmt: OK -> weekly scans + ticketing. Missing evidence of SLA on vuln triage for 2 vendors.
- Vendor management: partial -> vendor inventory up to date, DPAs missing for vendor-a, vendor-c -> ACTION: Legal to push vendor DPA signatures (owner: Aaron, due 3/15).
- Encryption/keys: partial -> KMS policies export present, key-rotation logs need formatting -> ACTION: Platform-eng to generate CSV rotation log (owner: Jordan, due 3/09).
- Physical security (if auditors ask for Private/on-prem): we have third-party SOC on-prem report placeholders; need to confirm scope per customer.

Open risks / blockers:
- Missing DPAs could delay vendor control evidence submission -> mitigation: provide attestation emails + procurement tickets as temporary evidence.
- Change-management artifacts inconsistent across infra repos -> need consistent template and export.
- Audit timeline tight if auditors request per-tenant artifacts for Dedicated customers.

Questions to pose to auditors (prepare phrasing):
1) "For change management, can you accept combined evidence: pull request history + RFC email threads + deployment runbook? If not, what is the minimum approval chain you require?"
2) "Regarding vendor risk, will redacted DPAs + procurement tickets be sufficient short-term while Legal secures formal signature?"
3) "For KMS/HSM, do you require raw key material logs or will policy snapshots + rotation metadata suffice?"
4) "Do you expect evidence to be organized per-control in a specific directory structure or is flat evidence ok?"

Action items (owner / due):
- Aaron Park: escalate DPAs for vendor-a, vendor-c, vendor-f. Due 2026-03-15.
- Jordan Lee: export key rotation logs (CSV), KMS policy snapshots + sample alerts. Due 2026-03-09.
- Samir Rao / infra: export service account creation history (pre-2024) + approval logs for past infra changes. Due 2026-03-10.
- Emily Chen: assemble SOC2 control mapping doc with per-control owner and current evidence links; highlight gaps. Due 2026-03-08.
- Priya (me): prepare auditor Q&A doc and walk-through script; produce a short slide deck (3 slides) showing timeline and hot issues. Due 2026-03-07.
- Legal: provide signed DPAs or attestation emails for flagged vendors. Point of contact: Aaron. Due 2026-03-15.

Prep checklist for my slides / walk-through (Priya):
- Slide 1: Audit scope & timeline (what we're giving auditors, dates).
- Slide 2: Top 5 open issues (DPAs, CM evidence, KMS logs, 2 infra vuln tickets, per-tenant scope).
- Slide 3: Action plan + owners + expected close dates.

Notes-to-self (informal):
- Bring up the idea of temporary "attestation bundles" if Legal needs more time to get DPAs signed — auditors sometimes accept signed procurement emails + screenshots.
- Ensure we have redaction process documented for any customer data in evidence.
- Double-check retention policies & log export ranges (we may need to extend window for some logs back to Jan 2025).

Meeting agenda (quick):
- 0:00-0:05 quick status + ask (what we need from Jordan/auditors)
- 0:05-0:15 review evidence gaps + owners
- 0:15-0:25 timeline confirmation & freeze date
- 0:25-0:35 blockers + mitigation plan
- 0:35-0:40 next steps + sync cadence (daily war room? every other day?)

Follow-ups post-1:1 (what I'll do right after):
- Send consolidated action list to #sec-audit and cc owners.
- Update Confluence control map with any changes Jordan requests.
- Create a single audit evidence folder (per auditor preference) and start uploading verified artifacts (tag with control IDs).

Misc notes / references:
- Control mapping: Confluence page (linked above). Use control IDs: CC-AC-1..CC-CM-3 for SOC2 mapping.
- Evidence naming convention: <control>-<artifact-type>-<date>-<owner> (e.g., CC-CM-2-deploy-approvals-20260303-Jordan).
- Slack threads: #sec-audit, #infra-deploys, #legal-contracts.

End of prep. Keep this doc messy — will clean final action list after 1:1.

-- Priya
